name: SaverOne 2014 Ltd
summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd is a technology enterprise dedicated to engineering, developing, and marketing advanced safety and transportation systems. Its core mission is to prevent vehicular accidents and thereby safeguard lives. Among its key innovations is the SaverOne Driver Distraction Prevention Solution, a sophisticated safety system currently under development. This technology is capable of detecting and monitoring mobile phones positioned near the driver, subsequently imposing selective blocks on applications deemed hazardous due to potential distraction. Furthermore, SaverOne is crafting solutions aimed at detecting vulnerable road users, enhancing overall road safety. Established in 2014, the company's main operations are based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
